t.rel: An Indian Ocean island country. In 2025 it signed a deal for Britain to hand over the disputed Chagos Islands, but after the United States withdrew its support, Britain put ratification on hold indefinitely in 2026. The United States and Britain were to keep using the Diego Garcia base.

t.etext: It started with sugar farming and expanded into tourism, textiles and offshore finance. It is counted among Africa's high-income countries with stable institutions.
